connector.name: Rate-My-Agent

connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.rate-my-agent.com over streamable HTTP. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.rate-my-agent.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
